run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-14T21:12:05Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by frontend's failing checkout calls: frontend's span error ratio went from 0% (buckets ending 20:52-21:07) to 0.45% at 21:12:05 and ~5.5% at 21:17:05 and 21:22:05, matching the alert start 21:12:05, and every frontend error span in the window sits on the checkout path (grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, tcp.connect), while cart, data, products, ads and recommendations show zero error spans. The dependency behind those calls is unavailable: pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q has 11 restarts, is in CrashLoopBackOff, its last termination was reason Error exitCode 2 after ~5s (21:17:53-21:17:58), deployment checkout has 1/1 unavailable, and the checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses, i.e. zero ready endpoints; checkout's own span rate dropped to 0 from 21:14:00. Checkout's own trace metrics contain no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, so this is availability, not checkout returning application errors. Why the checkout process exits with code 2 is NOT established: its crash output is not retained and no memory/restart-reason series exist, so the deepest cause remains unknown. frontend-proxy shows its own ingress/egress error spans with matching onset, consistent with propagating the same failed checkout requests.

claims.text: Frontend error spans over 20:12:05-21:30:20 are confined to the checkout path: span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR 418.15, span POST /api/checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR 418.15, span executing api route (pages) /api/checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR 418.15, span POST STATUS_CODE_ERROR 418.15 and span tcp.connect STATUS_CODE_ERROR 28.42; by contrast GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, GET /api/products/{productId}, POST /api/cart, GET / and the grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and RecommendationService/ListRecommendations client spans all show 0 error spans.
Frontend total STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase over the window is 1701.01 spans (service_name=frontend), versus 0 for accounting and payment, and 3.05/3.05/3.04 for ad/fraud-detection/recommendation.

Frontend span error percentage (100*rate(ERROR)/rate(all frontend spans), 5m) was 0 at 20:52:05, 20:57:05, 21:02:05 and 21:07:05, then 0.4546 at 21:12:05, 5.564 at 21:17:05 and 5.488 at 21:22:05, so the rise begins in the bucket ending at the alert start time 21:12:05.

Frontend client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error rate first became non-zero at 21:12:00 (0.0556/s), rose to 0.7222/s by 21:17:00 and stayed near 0.75/s, while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate fell from 0.7037/s at 21:10:00 to 0.0037/s at 21:17:00 and 0 at 21:22:00, i.e. essentially every PlaceOrder attempt from frontend was failing.

The checkout service stopped emitting spans: sum(rate(checkout spans,120s)) was 10.87-12.24/s from 21:02 to 21:10, 6.06/s at 21:11:00, 8.71/s at 21:12:00, 3.76/s at 21:13:00 and 0 from 21:14:00 through the end of the window.

Checkout's own trace metrics contain no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series over the window: every checkout span series (HTTP POST, orders publish, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart) is STATUS_CODE_UNSET only.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (owner ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, node i-01375feffdca65277) has container checkout with restartCount 11, ready=false, state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff with message back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout, and lastState terminated reason Error exitCode 2 startedAt 2026-11-14T21:17:53Z finishedAt 2026-11-14T21:17:58Z; pod conditions Ready and ContainersReady are False with reason ContainersNotReady.

Deployment checkout has replicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, observedGeneration 1 and condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable with lastTransitionTime 2026-11-14T21:17:58Z, so its only replica provides no minimum availability.

The checkout Service endpoints object has no ready address: its only subset contains notReadyAddresses with ip 100.96.4.26, nodeName i-01375feffdca65277 and targetRef Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q on port 8080 tcp-service, so callers of checkout:8080 have no ready backend.

Kubelet events for pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q in the window are: Created container checkout count 7 (last 21:13:53Z), Started container checkout count 7 (last 21:13:53Z), reason Killing with message Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted count 7 (last 21:13:58Z), and Warning reason BackOff Back-off restarting failed container checkout count 26 (last 21:18:46Z); these are the only events returned for namespace otel-demo in the window.

Checkout's downstream services show no error spans and lose traffic only after checkout stops: 5m span-rate buckets at 21:12:05 and 21:22:05 fell for currency (2.05 then 0.015 then 0), email (2.93 then 0.015 then 0), payment (1.48 then 0.007 then 0), shipping (2.20 then 0.011 then 0) and fraud-detection (1.47 then 0.007 then 0.004), while cart (20.10 then 14.23 then 15.92) and product-catalog (13.31 then 10.34 then 10.60) kept serving; payment's error series GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect are all 0.

frontend-proxy shows its own error spans: increase over the window of span ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR 437.43 and span router frontend egress STATUS_CODE_ERROR 420.18; per-5m error rate was near 0 up to 21:07:05 and then 0.0704/0.0593 at 21:12:05, 0.7296/0.7185 at 21:17:05 and 0.7593/0.7556 at 21:22:05.

Frontend exposes only traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket; no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count or rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series exist for it, so the alert cannot be tied to a named HTTP/gRPC duration metric here.

The retained checkout container log lines cover 2026-11-14T20:55:54Z-20:57:07Z and are normal PlaceOrder traffic ([PlaceOrder], payment went through, order placed, order confirmation email sent, Successful to write message, client/metadata fetching metadata for all topics from broker kafka:9092); the tool reported no previous checkout container instance.

Node i-01375feffdca65277 (host of the checkout pod) reports Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure False and last transitions on 2026-11-10, and its other otel-demo pods (cart, currency, email, kafka, frontend-proxy, otel-collector, valkey-cart, load-generator) are Running with 0 restarts, so no node-level resource pressure is observed for this incident.

The alert fires because checkout is unavailable: with zero ready endpoints for the checkout Service and the checkout container in CrashLoopBackOff, frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls fail (alongside 28.42 tcp.connect error spans), and frontend records POST /api/checkout as STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans, producing the non-zero frontend error ratio from about 21:12 onward.

frontend-proxy's error spans are the same failed checkout requests propagated through the proxy rather than an independent proxy fault: its router frontend egress error span count (420.18) is close to frontend's POST /api/checkout error count (418.15) and its error onset (0.0593/s in the bucket ending 21:12:05, 0.7185/s at 21:17:05) tracks frontend's PlaceOrder error rate (0.0556/s at 21:12:00, 0.7222/s at 21:17:00); per-route attribution of those proxy errors was not verified.

OOMKilled or memory-limit termination of the checkout container is not supported as the cause of the observed crash: the pod's last termination reason is Error with exitCode 2 (not OOMKilled or exit 137) and no Evicted event was returned; the reasons for the earlier restarts could not be read.

A failing downstream dependency of checkout is not supported as the cause of the frontend errors: payment, currency, shipping, email, cart, product-catalog and fraud-detection all show 0 error spans in the window and kept per-operation span rates until about 21:13 (payment error series GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect are 0), so their traffic loss around 21:14 is a consequence of checkout no longer calling them, not their own failure.

The 3.05/3.05/3.04 error spans on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation (all on span flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream) are not part of this incident: the same about 1.05 errors per 10-minute increase appears already in the bucket ending 21:12:05 and stays constant across buckets, indicating a steady baseline rather than the checkout-caused error burst.

Treat checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q as the failing workload: capture its exit-code-2 crash output (previous container logs or node container-runtime logs) and decide whether to roll back or raise replicas of the single-replica checkout deployment, since with replicas=1 and zero ready endpoints every POST /api/checkout from frontend now fails.

gaps: Reason for the checkout container's exit code 2 is unknown: the retained checkout log stream contains only 20:55:54-20:57:07 lines, a query restricted to 21:00:00-21:30:20 returned no log lines (status no_data), and the previous checkout container instance was reported as not found, so the crash output could not be read.

No kube_* metric series exist for this target (queries for kube_.* and kube_pod_container.* returned no data), so restart timestamps and reasons for the earlier 11 restarts and container memory usage are unknown rather than zero.

Jaeger holds no spans in the incident window: traces_search for frontend over 21:20:00-21:30:20 returned no data and the newest spans end near 21:05:00, so the gRPC status code and error detail of the failing frontend-to-checkout PlaceOrder calls were not observed.

The RequestErrorRate rule could not be retrieved (list_prometheus_rules for RequestErrorRate returned no data), so the alert's exact PromQL expression and its current value unit could not be confirmed.

Kafka pod logs returned no data for 21:05:00-21:30:20 and kafka has no trace metric series here, so kafka health as a possible trigger of the checkout crash is unverified; the kafka pod is Running with 0 restarts.
Frontend pod logs returned no data for 21:05:00-21:30:20, so the frontend-side error text for the failed checkout requests is unverified; frontend impact is known only from its span metrics.

The kubelet event Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count 7, last 21:13:58Z) could not be attributed: deployment checkout is still observedGeneration 1 with an unchanged pod-template-hash, and the change_history integration is not available, so what changed on the pod at about 21:13 is unknown.

trace_search_by_tags for service frontend with tag error=true returned no data over 21:00:00-21:30:20, so no individual error trace could be inspected for parent-child attribution; the frontend-to-checkout call edge is inferred only from frontend's own client span named grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder.
next_steps: Read the checkout container's previous-instance logs on node i-01375feffdca65277 (or extend log retention) to obtain the exit-code-2 stack trace and name the crash site.
Check whether anything patched the checkout pod or container spec in place around 21:13Z, given the kubelet Container definition changed events and the change_history integration being unavailable.
Confirm whether checkout recovered and whether frontend's error ratio returned to its pre-21:12 baseline of 0%.
